paragraphs: 3 former Mustangs appeared in professional games on Saturday for 3 clubs across 3 levels, with Zach Daudet producing the night's most notable performance.
Zach Daudet drove in his lone run with a walk in the seventh on a 3-2 pitch from Teddy Sharkey.
Zach Daudet went 0-for-1, 1 RBI, 1 run scored, 4 walks.
He batted fifth and started at shortstop.
Asheville Tourists fell to Frederick Keys, 7-8.
Alejandro Garza went 1-for-4, 1 run scored, 1 walk for Hill City Howlers at Single-A. He batted first and started at designated hitter. Hill City Howlers fell to Kannapolis Cannon Ballers, 5-7.
Brooks Lee went 0-for-4 for Minnesota Twins. He batted second and started at third base. Minnesota Twins fell to Chicago White Sox, 2-3.
title: Zach Daudet highlights a busy Saturday for former Mustangs
